# ezghcloud_kubernetes_pod_identity_association (Resource)

A pod identity association: pods using a service account get short-lived keys for a Bot. Nothing is stored in the cluster. The caller needs bots.pass on the Bot.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_id` (String) Bot (bot_) the pods get keys for. Changes in place; the next key is for the new Bot.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster (kcl_). Changing it replaces the association.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the association.
- `project_id` (String) The cluster's project. Changing it replaces the association.
- `service_account` (String) Kubernetes service account in the namespace. Changing it replaces the association.

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pod identity association ID (kpa_).
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_kubernetes_pod_identity_association.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/CLUSTER_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
